steps.en: Install the desktop app and sign in
steps.code: brew install --cask warp · winget install Warp.Warp

steps.en: Starts your existing shell and wraps each command plus its output into a block
steps.zh: 启动你原有的 shell，把每条命令连同输出包成一个块

steps.en: Describe the task to the built-in agent in plain language
steps.zh: 用大白话把任务告诉内置 agent

steps.en: Plans the next steps server-side and runs the commands back in your session
steps.zh: 在服务端规划下一步，再回到你的会话里执行命令

value.en: Command output, the agent and your follow-up commands live in one terminal instead of being copy-pasted between a terminal and a chat window
value.zh: 命令输出、agent 和后续命令都在同一个终端里，不再在终端和聊天窗口之间来回复制粘贴
